title: My Secret Life
author: Walter
current_text: In 1968, the Indecent Publications Tribunal ruled My Secret Life indecent except in the hands of people over 18 whose professional or academic studies covered its subject. In 1976, the Indecent Publications Tribunal again ruled My Secret Life indecent except in the hands of people over 18 whose professional or academic studies covered its subject.

ban_rows.note: In 1932, a New York publisher was arrested for issuing the first three volumes of 'My Secret Life'.
The NZ Indecent Publications Tribunal ruled it indecent except for persons over 18 with professional or academic interest, in 1968 and again in 1976 (per Wikipedia list).
In 1969, British printer Arthur Dobson was sentenced to two years in prison for producing a UK reprint of 'My Secret Life'.
